name: io.github.google/secops-soar-mcp
title: Google Security Operations SOAR MCP Server
description: Google Security Operations SOAR MCP server for case management, alerts, and playbook actions

environmentVariables.name: SOAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Google Security Operations SOAR tenant.

environmentVariables.name: SOAR_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API application key for Google Security Operations SOAR.

environmentVariables.name: SOAR_INTEGRATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of SOAR marketplace integrations to register.

endpoint_host.description: Hostname of a self-hosted or Cloud Run secops-soar-mcp Streamable HTTP deployment.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional OAuth 2.1 Bearer token when MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER_URL is enabled.
